(7 November 2014) | highest attendance = | lowest attendance = | average attendance = | prevseason = [[2013–14 Saudi First Division|2013–14]] | nextseason = [[2015–16 Saudi First Division|2015–16]] }} '''2014–15 Saudi First Division''' was the 38th season of [[Saudi First Division]] since its establishment in 1976. The season started on 15 August 2014 and concluded on 20 April 2015. Both [[Al-Qadisiyah FC|Al-Qadisiyah]] and [[Al-Wehda Club (Mecca)|Al-Wehda]] were promoted on the final day of the season. Al-Qadisiyah were crowned champions after a 2–0 away win against [[Al Hazm (football club)|Al-Hazm]] while Al-Wehda were promoted following a 1–0 away win against [[Al-Batin (football club)|Al-Batin]].{{cite web |title=صعود القادسية والوحدة الى مصاف أندية دوري عبد اللطيف جميل للمحترفين |url=https://www.elsport.com/news/show/251366/%D9%83%D8%B1%D8%A9-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%82%D8%AF%D9%85}} [[Al Safa FC|Al-Safa]], [[Abha Club|Abha]] and [[Hetten FC|Hetten]] were relegated to 2015–16 [[Saudi Second Division]]. ==Teams== The season featured 11 teams from the [[2013–14 Saudi First Division|2013–14 campaign]], two new teams relegated from the [[2013–14 Saudi Professional League|2013–14 Professional League]], [[Ettifaq FC|Al-Ettifaq]] and [[Al-Nahda Club (Saudi Arabia)|Al-Nahda]], and three new teams promoted from the 2013–14 [[Saudi Second Division]]. [[Al-Feiha FC|Al-Feiha]] were promoted as champions, [[Al Safa FC|Al-Safa]] as runners-up and [[Al-Mojzel Club|Al-Mojzel]] as the third-place play-offs winner.{{cite web |title=بالشعر والأوبريت الفيحاء يحتفل بصعوده لدوري ركاء و يدشن شعاره الجديد |url=https://www.sportksa.net/main/archives/102275}}{{cite web |title=الصفا يحقق الحلم بعد 65 عاما |url=https://arriyadiyah.com/443323}} ==Team changes== The following teams have changed division since the 2014–15 season. === To the First Division === '''Promoted from the [[2013–14 Saudi Second Division|Second Division]]''' * [[Al-Feiha FC|Al-Feiha]] * [[Al Safa FC|Al-Safa]] * [[Al-Mojzel Club|Al-Mojzel]] '''Relegated from the [[2013–14 Saudi Professional League|Pro League]]''' * [[Ettifaq FC|Al-Ettifaq]] * [[Al-Nahda Club (Saudi Arabia)|Al-Nahda]] === From the First Division === '''Relegated to the [[2014–15 Saudi Second Division|Second Division]]''' * [[Ohod Club|Ohod]] * [[Al-Ansar (Saudi Arabia)|Al-Ansar]] * [[Al Kawkb Club|Al-Kawkb]] '''Promoted to the [[2014–15 Saudi Professional League|Pro League]]''' * [[Hajer Club|Hajer]] * [[Khaleej FC|Al-Khaleej]] ==Stadia and locations==
